business_logic: 'Build candidate_journey by joining: - intermediate.int_lever__candidate_lifecycle (cl) to staging.stg_lever__opportunity (o) on opportunity_id, left join intermediate.int_lever__contact_info (c) on contact_id, join staging.stg_lever__stage (s) on o.stage_id, and left join staging.stg_lever__archive_reason (ar) on o.archived_reason_id. - Derive fields: - activity_status: constant ''Active''. - lifecycle_speed_category: total_lifecycle_days bucketed as ≤14 ''Fast'', ≤30 ''Standard'', ≤60 ''Slow'', else ''Very Slow''. - interview_completion_rate_pct: completed_interviews divided by total_interviews times 100, rounded to 1 decimal; no explicit zero-division guard; NULLs propagate. - Carry through totals (interviews, completed, canceled), avg_interview_duration_minutes, total_interview_time_minutes, avg_recommendation_score, feedback_completion_rate_pct, is_archived, application_date (o.created_at), last_interaction_at, last_advanced_at, current_stage (s.stage_name), archive_reason (ar.archive_reason_title). Compute communication_quality per opportunity_id: - days_from_application_to_last_contact: difference in days between last_interaction_at and application_date; NULL if either is NULL. - days_from_application_to_last_advancement: difference in days between last_advanced_at and application_date; NULL if either is NULL. - response_quality from days_since_last_advancement: ≤1 ''Excellent Response (≤1 day)''; ≤3 ''Good Response (2-3 days)''; ≤7 ''Moderate Response (4-7 days)''; ≤14 ''Slow Response (8-14 days)''; else ''Very Slow Response (>14 days)'' (NULL falls to the else bucket). - transparency_score from feedback_completion_rate_pct: ≥90→5; ≥70→4; ≥50→3; ≥30→2; else 1 (NULL falls to 1). Compute interview_experience per opportunity_id: - interview_experience_score: - If total_interviews = 0 → NULL. - Else if completion rate ≥95 and avg duration in 30–90 minutes → 5. - Else if completion rate ≥80 and avg duration in 20–120 minutes → 4. - Else if completion rate ≥60 → 3; else if ≥40 → 2; else → 1. - interview_burden_category: - If total_interviews = 0 → ''No Interviews''. - Else if total_interviews ≤2 and total_interview_time_minutes ≤120 → ''Light Process''; ≤4 and ≤240 → ''Standard Process''; ≤6 and ≤360 → ''Intensive Process''; else ''Heavy Process''. - interview_consistency_score: - If total_interviews = 0 → NULL. - Else if canceled_interviews = 0 → 5; else if canceled/total ≤10% → 4; ≤20% → 3; ≤30% → 2; else → 1. Compute outcome_fairness per opportunity_id: - outcome_fairness_score: - If not archived → NULL. - Else 5 for stage indicating hire/accept or reason indicating withdrew/declined; 4 for offer stage or skills/qualification mismatch; 3 for culture fit issues or other; 2 if rejected without a stated reason. - process_completeness_assessment: - If not archived → ''In Progress''; else if avg_recommendation_score ≥4 and stage does not indicate hire → ''Potential Mismatch''; else if avg_recommendation_score ≤2 → ''Consistent Outcome''; else if avg_recommendation_score is NULL → ''Incomplete Process''; else → ''Normal Process''. Compute timeline_experience per opportunity_id: - timeline_experience_score compares lifecycle_speed_category to labels ''Fast Track (≤7 days)'', ''Normal (8-30 days)'', ''Extended (31-60 days)'', ''Long Process (>60 days)''; because candidate_journey uses ''Fast''/''Standard''/''Slow''/''Very Slow'', no label matches and the else branch applies, yielding 1 for all rows. - candidate_anxiety_level from activity_status: ''Active'' maps to ''Low Anxiety''. Final projection and derived fields: - overall_candidate_experience_score: weighted average of subscores (transparency 20%, interview experience 25%, interview consistency 15%, outcome fairness 20%, timeline 20%), defaulting missing subscores to 3, rounded to 1 decimal. - experience_grade from the same rounded overall score: ≥4.5 ''Exceptional Experience''; ≥4.0 ''Excellent Experience''; ≥3.5 ''Good Experience''; ≥3.0 ''Average Experience''; ≥2.0 ''Below Average Experience''; else ''Poor Experience''. - improvement_recommendations: concatenate in this order (each fragment ends with ''; '' and no trimming): if transparency_score ≤2 add ''Improve feedback transparency; ''; if interview_experience_score ≤2 add ''Optimize interview process; ''; if timeline_experience_score ≤2 add ''Accelerate decision timeline; ''; if days_since_last_advancement ≥14 add ''Increase communication frequency; ''. - experience_risk_flag (first match): if days_since_last_advancement ≥21 and not archived → ''High Abandonment Risk''; else if canceled_interviews ≥2 → ''Poor Interview Experience''; else if transparency_score ≤2 and total_interviews ≥3 → ''Low Process Transparency''; else if timeline_experience_score ≤2 and total_lifecycle_days ≥60 → ''Extended Timeline Concern''; else ''Normal''. - calculated_at = current timestamp at model execution. - Final result ordered by overall_candidate_experience_score descending, then total_lifecycle_days ascending.'
LEFT JOIN staging.stg_lever__stage s

- name: key_finding_source
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Message based on source-type averages: Referred or Internal exceeding External by >10 triggers respective message; otherwise note no significant difference.'

CASE WHEN referred>external_avg+10 THEN 'Referral sources produce higher-quality candidates' WHEN internal>external_avg+10 THEN 'Internal mobility produces higher-quality candidates' ELSE 'No significant source difference' END key_finding_source

- name: key_finding_overall
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Message based on the share of high/exceptional candidates: ≥40% Strong, ≥25% Good, otherwise Opportunity.'

CASE WHEN (exceptional+highq)*1.0/nullif(total,0)>=.4 THEN 'Strong candidate quality distribution' WHEN (exceptional+highq)*1.0/nullif(total,0)>=.25 THEN 'Good candidate quality distribution' ELSE 'Opportunity to improve candidate quality' END key_finding_overall

- name: primary_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Recommendation driven by best source type: Referred → invest in referrals; Internal → promote mobility; otherwise optimize external channels.'

CASE WHEN (SELECT source_type FROM src WHERE rn=1)='Referred' THEN 'Invest in referral programs' WHEN (SELECT source_type FROM src WHERE rn=1)='Internal' THEN 'Promote internal mobility' ELSE 'Optimize external channels' END primary_recommendation

- name: process_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Recommendation from comparing rounded average lifecycle days: if high-quality is faster, fast-track; otherwise improve early screening.'
CASE WHEN highdays<lowdays THEN 'Fast-track high-quality candidates' ELSE 'Improve early screening' END process_recommendation

- name: referral_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage with 2 decimals; referred applications divided by total applications *100; 0 when no applications; joined on department+team only
count(DISTINCT referrer_user_id) AS referred

        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Tier by interview_hours_per_hire thresholds (≤10 Highly Efficient, ≤20 Efficient, ≤40 Moderate Efficiency, else Low Efficiency; No Hires when hires=0); COALESCE to 'No Data' if join missing; replicated across rows
'No Data' AS cost_efficiency_tier

- name: total_interviews_conducted
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct interviews at department+team; replicated across rows; COALESCE to 0
0::BIGINT AS total_interviews_conducted

- name: unique_interviewers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct interviewer users at department+team; replicated across rows; COALESCE to 0
0::BIGINT AS unique_interviewers

- name: avg_interview_duration_minutes
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average interview duration in minutes at department+team; NULL→0 via COALESCE; replicated across rows
0.0 AS avg_interview_duration_minutes

derive posting_month and posting_quarter by truncating created_at. - application_volume (dept+team+location+level+commitment_type+month+quarter): - Distinct counts: applications, candidates, opportunities, postings; referred applications where referrer_user_id is present. - referral_rate = referred applications / total applications * 100, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no applications. - avg_applications_per_posting = total applications / active postings, rounded to 1 decimal; NULL when active postings=0 (later COALESCE to 0). - hiring_outcomes (dept+team): - candidates_hired: distinct opportunities with stage name containing ''hire'' or ''accept''; offers_extended: distinct opportunities with stage name containing ''offer''. - Averages for hired/accepted only: time_to_hire (lifecycle days) and interviews_per_hire. - hire_conversion_rate = candidates_hired / distinct opportunities * 100, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no opportunities. - offer_acceptance_rate = candidates_hired / offers_extended * 100, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no offers. - interview_metrics (dept+team): - total_interviews_conducted: distinct interviews; completed when not canceled; canceled when canceled. - unique_interviewers: distinct interviewer users; avg_interview_duration: average interview duration (minutes); total_interview_time_minutes: sum of durations. - interview_completion_rate = completed / total * 100, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no interviews. - feedback_completion_rate = 100 when any feedback exists else 0, rounded to 2 decimals. - candidate_quality (dept+team): - avg_candidate_experience_score: average overall_candidate_experience_score. - positive_experience_rate = exceptional/excellent experience opportunities / total opportunities * 100, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no opportunities. - avg_screening_pass_rate: average application_to_screening_rate; high_efficiency_postings: distinct postings with hiring_efficiency_grade=''High Efficiency (≥10%)''. - cost_efficiency (dept+team): - Join dpb to application_volume, hiring_outcomes, and interview_metrics on dept+team; group by dept+team. - total_interview_hours = sum(total_interview_time_minutes) / 60.0. - interview_hours_per_hire = total_interview_hours / total hires, rounded to 1 decimal; NULL when no hires (later COALESCE to 0). - applications_per_hire = sum(total_applications) / total hires, rounded to 1 decimal; NULL when no hires (later COALESCE to 0). - hires_per_posting = total hires / sum(active_postings), rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no active postings. - cost_efficiency_tier by interview_hours_per_hire: ≤10 Highly Efficient, ≤20 Efficient, ≤40 Moderate Efficiency, >40 Low Efficiency; No Hires when hires=0 (later COALESCE to ''No Data'' if join missing). - Note: dept+team joins cause ho/im to repeat across each application_volume row and posting; sums aggregate repeated rows (scaled by both postings and application_volume rows per dept+team), while ratios dividing repeated sums (e.g., interview_hours_per_hire) cancel the scaling. - Final assembly: - Join department_posting_base to all aggregates on dept+team only, replicating dept+team metrics across each posting’s location/level/commitment slice and across application_volume slices. - Keep rows where application_volume.total_applications>0 OR application_volume.active_postings>0. - Ranks (global across the final set): hiring_volume_rank by candidates_hired DESC, conversion_efficiency_rank by hire_conversion_rate DESC, candidate_experience_rank by avg_candidate_experience_score DESC; ties share rank with gaps. - department_performance_score (0–100, rounded to 0 decimals, clamped): min(25, hires*2.5) + (hire_conversion_rate*0.2) + (interview_completion_rate*0.2) + (positive_experience_rate*0.15) + ([cost_efficiency_tier in {Highly Efficient, Efficient} → 20 else 10]*0.2). - performance_tier: ≥75 Top Performing Department; ≥60 High Performing Department; ≥45 Standard Performing Department; else if total_applications≥10 Underperforming Department; otherwise Low Activity Department. - department_strength priority: referral_rate≥30 → offer_acceptance_rate≥80 → avg_candidate_experience_score≥4.0 → avg_time_to_hire_days≤30 → cost_efficiency_tier in {Highly Efficient, Efficient} → else Standard Operations. - calculated_at = current_timestamp; business_logic: '- Use intermediate.int_lever__opportunity_contact_info as the base; each output row represents one opportunity_id from this base. - Inner join staging.stg_lever__stage on stage_id to add current_stage; opportunities without a matching stage are excluded. - Left join staging.stg_lever__archive_reason on archived_reason_id to add archive_reason; if no match, archive_reason is NULL. - Left join intermediate.int_lever__opportunity_tags on opportunity_id to add tags; if no match, tags is NULL. - Determine the most recent offer per candidate by ordering each candidate’s offers by created_at descending and selecting the single most recent record; if multiple offers have the same created_at for a candidate, one is chosen arbitrarily. - Left join this most recent offer to opportunities on opportunity_id; set has_offer to true when a most recent offer exists for this opportunity, otherwise false; set current_offer_status to the joined offer’s status or NULL if no offer joined. - Left join staging.stg_lever__posting on posting_id to add job_title, job_commitment, job_location, job_team, and current_state_of_job_posting; if no match, these fields are NULL. - All other columns are passed through unchanged from the base; NULLs and original values are preserved. No explicit ordering is applied in the result.'
PARTITION BY opportunity_id ORDER BY created_at DESC

business_logic: 'Build daily account-level conversion funnel metrics and 30-day cohort summaries: - daily_events (union all) - Page views: from staging.stg_pendo__event as event_type=page_view; fields include visitor_id, account_id, app_id, event_date (day-level from occurred_at), entity_id=page_id, num_events, num_minutes. - Feature interactions: from staging.stg_pendo__feature_event as event_type=feature_click; entity_id=feature_id; carry num_events and num_minutes. - Deep page interactions: from staging.stg_pendo__page_event as event_type=page_interaction; per visitor/account/app/day/page aggregate counts of interactions (num_events) and summed minutes (num_minutes). - user_daily_funnel (per visitor_id, account_id, app_id, event_date) - Presence flags by type: has_page_view, has_feature_interaction, has_deep_interaction set to 1 if any such event exists that day, else 0. - Distinct entities: unique_pages_viewed, unique_features_used, unique_pages_interacted are distinct counts of entity_id by type. - Totals: total_page_events/total_feature_events/total_interaction_events and corresponding minutes are summed by type. - funnel_progression (per visitor/day) - Funnel stage precedence: Deep Engaged (all three flags=1) > Feature User (page and feature flags=1) > Page Visitor (page flag=1) > No Activity. - engagement_score = 0.1×total_page_events + 0.3×total_feature_events + 0.6×total_interaction_events + 0.05×(total_page_minutes + total_feature_minutes + total_interaction_minutes). - session_quality: High Quality if total_minutes≥10 and unique_pages_viewed≥3 and unique_features_used≥2; else Medium Quality if total_minutes≥5 and unique_pages_viewed≥2; else Low Quality if total_page_minutes≥1; else Bounce. Here total_minutes = total_page_minutes + total_feature_minutes + total_interaction_minutes. - account_funnel_metrics (per account_id, app_id, event_date) - Visitor counts: total_visitors = distinct visitor_id; visitors_with_page_views/features/deep = distinct visitors with the corresponding presence flag=1. - Conversion rates: page_to_feature = visitors_with_feature_use / visitors_with_page_views; feature_to_deep = visitors_with_deep_engagement / visitors_with_feature_use; overall = visitors_with_deep_engagement / visitors_with_page_views. If the denominator is 0, the rate is NULL. - Averages: avg_engagement_score and avg_pages_per_visitor are averaged over visitors with has_page_view=1; avg_features_per_user over visitors with has_feature_interaction=1; if no qualifying visitors, result is NULL. - Quality rates: high_quality_session_rate = distinct visitors with session_quality=''High Quality'' divided by total_visitors; bounce_rate = distinct visitors with session_quality=''Bounce'' divided by total_visitors; NULL if total_visitors=0. - conversion_cohort_analysis (per account_id, app_id; joined back to each daily row) - 30-day rolling averages relative to today (lower bound inclusive): average of daily page_to_feature, feature_to_deep, and overall conversion rates for dates on or after 30 days before today. - conversion_rate_trend = average overall conversion rate for dates on or after 7 days before today minus the average for dates from 30 to 7 days before today; both windows include the day 7 days ago. - funnel_health_rating by the 30-day average overall rate: Excellent (≥0.3), Good (≥0.2), Fair (≥0.1), else Poor. If the 30-day average is NULL, rating is Poor. - optimization_recommendation (first matching rule): if the 30-day average page→feature rate < 0.2 then “Focus on feature discovery and onboarding”; else if the 30-day average feature→deep rate < 0.3 then “Improve feature engagement and user guidance”; else if the 30-day average bounce rate > 0.6 then “Reduce bounce rate through better landing experience”; else “Maintain current optimization efforts”. - Final step: left join the cohort metrics to the daily account_funnel_metrics by account_id and app_id; set calculated_at to the query execution timestamp. Distinct counting ensures a visitor is counted once per day; averages ignore NULLs; no rounding is applied.'

SELECT account_id,app_id,CAST(occurred_at AS DATE) event_date,count(DISTINCT visitor_id) total_visitors,count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN page_id IS NOT NULL THEN visitor_id END) visitors_with_page_views,count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN num_events>0 THEN visitor_id END) visitors_with_feature_use,count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN num_minutes>=1 THEN visitor_id END) visitors_with_deep_engagement FROM staging.stg_pendo__event GROUP BY 1,2,3

business_logic: '- NPS metrics (by account_id from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_nps_rating): - total_nps_responses is the total row count per account; avg_nps_score is the mean of nps_rating (ignoring NULLs). - promoter_rate is the share of rows with nps_rating ≥ 9 using total_nps_responses as the denominator (NULL ratings not counted in the numerator but included in the denominator). - detractor_rate is the share of rows with nps_rating ≤ 6 using total_nps_responses as the denominator (NULL ratings not counted in the numerator but included in the denominator). - net_promoter_score = promoter_rate − detractor_rate. - Feature adoption metrics (by app_id, account_id from staging.stg_pendo__feature_event): - total_features_available is distinct features; features_used is distinct features with any usage (>0 events); features_heavily_used is distinct features with ≥10 events. - total_users is distinct visitors; active_feature_users is distinct visitors with any feature usage (>0 events). - feature_adoption_rate = features_used ÷ total_features_available (returns NULL when total_features_available = 0). - feature_depth_adoption_rate = features_heavily_used ÷ total_features_available (returns NULL when total_features_available = 0). - user_feature_adoption_rate = active_feature_users ÷ total_users (returns NULL when total_users = 0). - avg_features_per_user = features_used ÷ active_feature_users (returns NULL when active_feature_users = 0). - Distinct counts exclude NULL IDs; duplicates are removed. - Visitor aggregated metrics (by account_id, visitor_id from staging.stg_pendo__event): - count_active_days is the distinct count of active calendar days; sum_events and sum_minutes are totals across events; last_event_on is the most recent active calendar day. - User retention metrics (by account_id from visitor_aggregated_metrics): - total_users is distinct visitors. - retention_7d/30d/90d are the shares of visitors whose last_event_on is within 7/30/90 days of current_date; denominators are total_users (no explicit zero-division guard). - highly_active_user_rate is the share of visitors with count_active_days ≥ 20 (denominator is total_users; no explicit zero-division guard). - avg_lifetime_events is the mean of sum_events per visitor; avg_active_days_per_user is the mean of count_active_days per visitor. - Engagement quality metrics (by account_id, app_id from staging.stg_pendo__event): - avg_session_duration is the mean minutes per session; avg_events_per_session is the mean events per session (NULLs ignored in averages). - unique_users is distinct visitors; total_sessions is the session row count; sessions_per_user = total_sessions ÷ unique_users (no explicit zero-division guard). - deep_engagement_session_rate is the share of sessions with ≥10 minutes or ≥20 events (denominator is total_sessions). - power_user_rate assumes 20% are high-frequency users: equals 0.2 when unique_users > 0, else NULL. - Product health scores: - Join feature_adoption_metrics (fam) and user_retention_metrics (urm) with a full outer join on account_id. - Join engagement_quality_metrics (eqm) with a full outer join on the coalesced account_id from fam/urm and require app_id to match fam.app_id; rows with only engagement data are kept but will have app_id NULL in the output. - Join nps_metrics (nm) with a left join on the coalesced account_id from fam/urm; NPS does not attach for engagement-only rows. - account_id is coalesced from fam, then urm, then eqm; app_id comes only from fam. - overall_health_score is a 0–100 score capped at 100, computed as the sum of: - up to 25 points from NPS by scaling net_promoter_score from [-1,1] to [0,25] (missing treated as 0), - up to 25 points from feature_adoption_rate (missing treated as 0), - up to 25 points from retention_30d (missing treated as 0), - up to 25 points from engagement: deep_engagement_session_rate (up to 12.5) and power_user_rate (up to 12.5) (missing treated as 0). - Health categorization: - health_grade: Excellent (score ≥ 80), Good (≥ 60), Fair (≥ 40), Poor (≥ 20), else Critical. - primary_improvement_area (first match wins): if net_promoter_score is missing treat as −1; if feature_adoption_rate, retention_30d, or deep_engagement_session_rate are missing treat as 0; then check in order: NPS < 0, adoption < 0.3, 30‑day retention < 0.5, deep engagement < 0.2; otherwise maintain/optimize. - risk_level: High Risk if score < 30; Medium Risk if (score < 50 and 30‑day retention < 0.4, treating missing retention as 0) or net_promoter_score < −0.2 (treating missing NPS as 0); else Low. - calculated_at is set to the current timestamp at execution.'
